name: Import & export
subtitle: Move rules in and out as text. Everything on this screen is copy-and-paste — there is nothing to upload and nothing to download.

elements.label: Paste your rules here
elements.hint: Open the file you exported from your old site in a spreadsheet or a text editor, select everything, copy it, and paste it into this box. There is no file picker on this screen — the text is the upload.

elements.label: What is in the box below
Copy your rules from here
elements.hint: Every rule you have, in the same format the box above accepts. Click inside, select all, and copy. To keep it as a file, paste it into a text editor and save it with a .csv ending — a spreadsheet will then open it as columns. Copy this before a big import, and you have a way back.
